purpose: Machine-readable API index for Owlkei Go framework

public_surface.source_of_truth: api/owlkei.txt (make api writes it, make api-check diffs it); design 0017
root_functions: OptionsFromEnv() *core.AppOptions (OK_<PATH> variables with __ between levels, PORT, ./.env; environment > .env; code assigned afterwards wins; every error stops New)
Retry(ctx context.Context, opts *core.RetryOptions, fn func(context.Context) error) error
public_surface.note: The packages below are documented by their internal name (core, ctx, common, aggregation, versioning live under internal/); applications reach them only through the root aliases. log.Logger and log.LogAdapter moved from common to log.

core.responsibility: Application lifecycle, server, handler invocation, DI container (user docs: README.md; maintainer docs: internal/core/README.md)

App.description: Main application container; every owlkei.New(opts) is independent (own routes, providers, layers, logger, publisher). The whole configuration is the *AppOptions given to New (design 0022)

methods.name: New
methods.purpose: Create an app from its options (nil = defaults); reads opts once, copies what it keeps, makes every check (panics `invalid app: <Group>.<Field> …`), compiles the pre-route stages in their fixed order

methods.name: Create
methods.purpose: Wire the module tree, plan handlers, run OnReady (call once; panics on misuse)

methods.name: Listen
methods.purpose: Serve on :Server.Port (default 3000): HTTPS with HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 when Server.TLS holds a certificate, else HTTP/1.1 (and h2c with Server.IsH2C); blocks until shut down

methods.name: Serve
methods.purpose: Serve on a listener you made, same TLS and protocol rules; ignores Server.Port

methods.name: Stop
methods.purpose: Graceful shutdown (drain, then OnShutdown hooks once); safe from any goroutine; from a handler use go app.Stop()

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.purpose: App is an http.Handler (advanced: no server defaults, no graceful shutdown)

methods.name: Get
methods.purpose: The instance this app created for p's type, nil before Create or for an unknown type; nil while the provider's module is not ready (AsyncImports)

methods.name: BindGlobalMiddlewares
methods.purpose: Middlewares for every HTTP request, after the pre-route stages, and once per WebSocket connection at the handshake

methods.name: BindGlobalGuards
methods.purpose: Guards for every route and event

methods.name: BindGlobalInterceptors
methods.purpose: Interceptors for every route and event

methods.name: BindGlobalExceptionFilters
methods.purpose: Exception filters for every route and event

notes: Configuration is AppOptions, checked at New. The BindGlobal* methods panic after Create: 'invalid app: <Method> must be called before Create'. There are no Enable* / Set* methods and no ListenTLS.

The request body cap is AppOptions.HTTP.MaxBodyBytes (a ByteSize: 0 = 10 MiB, negative = off), also when App runs in your own http.Server; ServeHTTP wraps a body (not nil / http.NoBody) in http.MaxBytesReader. Exceeding it is a 413 exception from ctx.Body(). No SetMaxBodySize-style method exists.

Server timeouts are internal defaults, not options: ReadHeaderTimeout 5 s, ReadTimeout 30 s, WriteTimeout 30 s, IdleTimeout 75 s, MaxHeaderBytes 64 KiB. Deeper tuning: run App as an http.Handler in your own http.Server.
The logger is AppOptions.Logger, read with Logger(); App has no exported fields.

Built-in protections are pre-route stages configured in AppOptions, each off until configured, in the fixed order loadshed → proxy → hostcheck → httpsredirect → headers → cors → csrf → compress, before routing and user middlewares. There are no public built-in middlewares (internal/middlewares/*).
SecurityCheck: one Warn at the end of Create when the app has SUBMIT_ routes without CSRF or RENDER_ routes without Headers; IsEnabled or IsDisabled on the group silences it; no behavior change.

Module.description: Composition root for controllers and providers with lifecycle hooks; fields set on the built module
fields: Name string - resolved by Build from the variable or function name (<package>.<name>); used in the InstanceLoader log line
IsGlobal bool - makes providers available to every module without an explicit import
OnInit func() - called during app.Create(), a module after the modules it imports, then its providers are constructed; for a module not ready at Create, in the background before its providers
OnReady func() - called once per app at the end of app.Create(), in the OnInit order; for a module not ready at Create, right after its gate opens
OnShutdown func() - called on graceful shutdown (SIGINT/SIGTERM, or app.Stop()), in the exact reverse of the OnInit order; only for ready modules, in the reverse of the order they became ready
methods: Prefix(prefix string) *Module - path prefix for the module's routes and its imports' routes
ID() string - identifier given by Build

ModuleBuilder.description: Fluent API for building modules: core.NewModuleBuilder() (owlkei.ModuleBuilder()) returns a new *core.ModuleBuilder
methods: Imports(modules ...any) *ModuleBuilder - *Module values or module factories (func(deps...) *core.Module, func(deps...) (*core.Module, error), func(ctx, deps...) (*core.Module, error)); fail fast at Create
AsyncImports(modules ...any) *ModuleBuilder - the same entries, built in the background; dependents pending (routes 503) until ready; one entry in both lists panics

PathStyle(style common.PathStyle) *ModuleBuilder - PathStyleKebab (default: READ_user_profile -> /user-profile) or PathStyleAsWritten (/user_profile); inherited by imports like Prefix, an explicit setting wins; another value panics `invalid module: PathStyle needs owlkei.PathStyleKebab or owlkei.PathStyleAsWritten`
ModuleBuilder.notes: No Export or IsGlobal builder methods exist: set m.IsGlobal on the built module.

AppOptions.description: Argument of New (root alias owlkei.AppOptions); nil = defaults; documented in README.md › Configuration with each field's default and OK_* variable
fields: Logger log.LogAdapter - default log.NewLog(nil); code only
StartupTimeout time.Duration - budget of Create for Imports factories (default 30s); OK_STARTUP_TIMEOUT
IsAccessLog bool - one access line per request and WS message; OK_IS_ACCESS_LOG
IsDevtool bool - devtool snapshot at Create; OK_IS_DEVTOOL
Server *ServerOptions - Port (3000; OK_SERVER__PORT, else PORT), ShutdownTimeout (30s), TLS *TLSOptions{CertFile, KeyFile, Config (code only)}, IsH2C
HTTP *HTTPOptions - MaxBodyBytes ByteSize (10MiB, negative = no limit; OK_HTTP__MAX_BODY_BYTES), ServeDirs []string (declared, not enforced yet)
Render *RenderOptions - pages, on when FS is set (code only); Dir (web), IsReload
WS *WSOptions - WebSocket endpoint, on when Path is set; OK_WS__PATH
Versioning *VersioningOptions - on when Type is set; Key (v), DefaultVersion, Extractor (code only)
Proxy *ProxyOptions - on when TrustedProxies or TrustedHops (1-16) is set, exactly one; Header ProxyHeader (ProxyHeaderXForwarded | ProxyHeaderForwarded), IsHostForwarded
Hosts []string - host names answered, others 421; empty = every host; at most 256
Origins []string - one list for CORS, CSRF and the WebSocket handshake: scheme://host[:port] lower case, scheme://*.host, or "*" alone; at most 256; panics when CORS, CSRF and WS are all off
LoadShed *LoadShedOptions - IsEnabled, MaxInFlight (0 = adaptive), MaxQueue (64, negative = none)
HTTPSRedirect *HTTPSRedirectOptions - IsEnabled, Host (request's host), Port (443)
Headers *HeadersOptions - IsEnabled, IsDisabled (off on purpose, silences SecurityCheck), eight header strings ("" = default, "-" = not sent)
CORS *CORSOptions - IsEnabled (needs Origins), AllowMethods, AllowHeaders, ExposeHeaders, MaxAge (10m), IsAllowCredentials, IsAllowPrivateNetwork
CSRF *CSRFOptions - IsEnabled, IsDisabled; trusted origins come from Origins; no token, no cookie
Compress *CompressOptions - IsEnabled, MinSize ByteSize (1KiB)
notes: A group with a required field is on when that field is set; a group whose fields are all optional has IsEnabled. A field set while its group is off panics at New.
ByteSize: plain bytes; constants owlkei.KB / MB / GB (1000ⁿ) and KiB / MiB / GiB (1024ⁿ); in a variable a whole number with one of those units, case-sensitive; a lower-case b is refused.

ServerOptions.description: AppOptions.Server: applies when Owlkei opens the listener (Listen, Serve); no effect when App is only an http.Handler
fields: Port int - TCP port of Listen (0 = 3000); Serve ignores it
ShutdownTimeout time.Duration - drain time at shutdown (0 = 30 s; negative panics at New)
TLS *TLSOptions - CertFile + KeyFile (PEM, loaded at New) and/or Config *tls.Config (cloned); HTTPS with HTTP/2
IsH2C bool - unencrypted HTTP/2 without TLS; with TLS panics at New

RenderOptions.description: AppOptions.Render (root alias owlkei.RenderOptions); pages are on when FS is set

fields.FS: fs.FS, required: holds Dir. In Dir: layout.html per directory, top-level partials/, root error pages <400-599>.html / 4xx.html / 5xx.html, assets/ served at /assets/*, public/ served at the root URL, X.css / X.js next to X.html (linked by {{pageAssets}}, served at /assets/_pages/...), every other .html is the template of the page route with that path (<path>.html or <path>/index.html) and stops Create without one
fields.Dir: string: the directory of FS holding the files (default web, . for the root of FS)
fields.IsReload: bool: re-parse when a template file's name, size or modification time changed, checked per render; assets read per request, no-cache, no ?v= (development only)

Controller.description: Any struct implementing NewController() Controller; embeds common.HTTP and/or common.WS

ctx.responsibility: Request context objects and dependency types

methods: Status(code int) *HTTPContext - sets the status code; chain with JSON/Text
JSON(data any, args ...any) - string = raw JSON, JSONAppender = own bytes, else encoding/json; encode error panics 500 and writes nothing
JSONP(data any, args ...any) - sanitized callback, nosniff, falls back to JSON
Body() Body - lazily parses JSON body; on http.MaxBytesError panics exception.RequestEntityTooLargeException (413), not a raw error
HTTPContext.notes: No SetDeadline()/IsDeadlineExceeded()/Deadline field exist on HTTPContext — do not invent per-request deadline APIs. See metadata-concurrency-model.json's cancellation_handling for the real (server-level-only) timeout model.

common.responsibility: Pipeline interfaces and embedded controller types
notes: Guards, interceptors and exception filters are bound as `any` (no named type), NOT compile-time Go interfaces. Shape is checked at bind time by method name and signature (a type assertion to an unexported interface, then the method value; no reflection per call) against the func-type aliases below. A layer bound to a method that is not a handler of the controller panics at Create(). A bound value missing the method panics with a *ShapeError (GuardShapeError / InterceptorShapeError / ExceptionFilterShapeError).
MiddlewareFn IS a real interface (requires a Use method) — different from the other three.

interfaces.MiddlewareFn: interface { Use(*http.Request, http.ResponseWriter, ctx.Next) } — real interface; Use = func(*http.Request, http.ResponseWriter, ctx.Next) is the matching func alias
interfaces.guard: any; checked against HTTPCanActivate = func(*ctx.HTTPContext) bool via method name "CanActivate"
interfaces.interceptor: any; checked against HTTPIntercept = func(*ctx.HTTPContext, *aggregation.Aggregation) any via method name "Intercept"
interfaces.exception filter: any; checked against HTTPCatch = func(*ctx.HTTPContext, *exception.Exception) via method name "Catch" — NOTE: HTTPContext is the FIRST parameter, Exception is SECOND
interfaces.Logger: interface { Debug(msg string, args ...any); Info(...); Warn(...); Error(...); Fatal(...) } — no Log()/LogStructured() methods exist
interfaces.Publisher: interface { Publish(topic string, payload ...any) error } — payload is variadic, not a single `data any`

embedded_types.HTTP: Embed in controller to enable HTTP routing (there is NO common.REST type — do not generate it)
embedded_types.HTTP methods: Prefix(v string, handlers ...any) *HTTP (controller prefix, may hold {param}); Path(v string, handlers ...any) *HTTP (exact path replacing what the name spells; prefixes, method and version still apply). There is no Page embed and no View type: RENDER_ / SUBMIT_ methods of an HTTP controller are page routes (needs AppOptions.Render.FS), the result is the template's data; 200 for RENDER_, 422 for a SUBMIT_ that renders, c.Redirect without a 3xx status answers 303, errors from the first guard on are HTML
embedded_types.WS: Embed in controller to enable WebSocket routing
embedded_types.Middleware: Separate embeddable type providing BindMiddleware(MiddlewareFn, ...any) *Middleware — not a field on HTTP/WS

http_methods.RENDER: GET page (template by route, needs AppOptions.Render.FS)
http_methods.SUBMIT: POST on the path of the RENDER_ with the same words (same controller)

path_separators.BY: path parameter ({name}, the exact text of the method name)
path_separators.AND: one more parameter of the current resource
path_separators.OF: parent resource, placed before the current one
path_separators.FILE: the joint before the preceding word becomes '.' (READ_robots_txt_FILE -> /robots.txt)
path_separators.ALL: WebSocket only, last word: ** (one or more segments)

routing_tokens.path_style: resource words joined with '-' (PathStyleKebab, default) or '_' (PathStyleAsWritten, set with ModuleBuilder().PathStyle); never applied to prefixes, Path, parameters, versions or events. An upper-case word that is not a route word panics `invalid route: <W> in <Name> is upper case but not a route word; write it in lower case or camelCase`

notes: Router.Match signature is func (r *Router) Match(method, path, version string, params []string) (*RouterItem, []string): nil on a miss; the item is shared and read-only; the slice is params plus one value per route parameter (design 0002). Router.Group does not exist.
Route parameters are {name} whole segments (READ_BY_ID routes to GET /{ID}: the parameter name keeps the case of the method name); there is no :id syntax.

render.responsibility: internal/render, not importable: html/template sets of RenderOptions.FS parsed once at Create and bound to page routes by path (Bind), error pages by status, pooled buffers (dropped past 256 KiB, 8 MiB page limit), the {{nonce}} placeholder overwritten in place, the asset hash table (docs: internal/render/README.md)

template_functions.nonce: the response's CSP nonce, 32 lowercase hex from crypto/rand, same in helmet's header
template_functions.asset: /assets/<path>?v=<first 8 bytes of SHA-256 as hex>; no ?v= with IsReload; unknown file fails the render
template_functions.dict: map[string]any from key/value pairs, for partials
template_functions.pageAssets: <link> / <script defer> tags of the CSS and JS files named after the layout and the page, at /assets/_pages/<path>?v=<hash>; built once per page set

Exception.notes: No GetStackTrace()/SetStackTrace() and no stack-trace field exist. Exception{message, description, cause, code, isJoined} holds no prebuilt error; Error() derives the text. AppendJSON / MarshalJSON write {"code","error","message"} with encoding/json.

trace.tracer: type Tracer (zero value ready): Enabled() bool, Emit(Event), Listen(func(Event)) (stop func()); synchronous, no recover, 0 allocs. There is no event bus. core keeps one Tracer per app, unexported: AppOptions.IsAccessLog adds its only listener.
trace.notes: No "handshake" stage exists. Interceptor is split into pre_interceptor/post_interceptor (two constants), not one combined "interceptor". Exception filter stage string is "exception_filter", not "filter".

memorybroker.responsibility: Lightweight in-process topic-based pub/sub broker (no queue groups, no persistence, no ack/retry)

Message.description: Published message (no ID, no Metadata — removed in simplification)
fields: Topic string - Topic name
Payload any - Message data
Timestamp time.Time - captured via time.Now() before dispatch

pattern_types: Exact: 'user.login' - O(1) map lookup, matches only that topic
Suffix: 'user.**' - O(1) map lookup by prefix; matches one or more segments below 'user.', not 'user'
Global: '**' - O(1), matches all topics. '*' is exactly one segment ('*' alone: single-segment topics); '**' is special only as the last segment; '>' is literal
Complex: 'user.*', 'user.*.profile', '*.created' - O(n) scan; segment-wildcard matching, NOT regex. Full table: internal/pattern/MATCHING.md
key_features: Single sync.RWMutex over 4 maps (exact/prefix/global/complex) - no sharding
PublishAsync: one goroutine per call tracked by sync.WaitGroup, no worker pool/bounded queue
Close(): CompareAndSwap-idempotent, waits for in-flight PublishAsync via WaitGroup, then clears all maps
Cross-broker Unsubscribe protection via ErrForeignSubscription (checks subscription.broker == receiver)
Unsubscribe(nil) is always nil, unconditionally, even after Close
Unconditional panic recovery per handler call (not configurable, no OnPanic hook)
publishInternal sizes handler slice exactly, skips allocation entirely when nothing matches

memorycache.responsibility: Bounded in-memory sharded byte cache with exact TTL and an atomic counter, no persistence

MemoryCacheOptions.description: MaxEntries int (default 65536, rounded down to a multiple of 64, minimum 64); MaxBytes int64 (default 16 MiB, minimum 64 KiB)

MemoryCache.description: In-memory cache, 64 shards with CLOCK eviction, bounded by MaxEntries and MaxBytes
constructors: NewMemoryCache(opts *MemoryCacheOptions) *MemoryCache - nil means the defaults; starts no goroutine and no timer
methods: Set(ctx, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) error
SetNX(ctx, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) (bool, error)
Incr(ctx, key string, delta int64, ttl time.Duration) (int64, error) - atomic 8-byte big-endian counter; a live counter keeps its expiry

notes: No file-based persistence anywhere in this package. Do NOT invent PersistenceConfig / NewMemoryCacheWithConfig — they do not exist and never have in current source.
There is no Stop method: the sweep is a time.AfterFunc armed only while an entry with a ttl exists, holding the cache through a weak.Pointer.
Errors: ErrEmptyKey, ErrNegativeTTL (negative ttl writes nothing), ErrEntryTooLarge (len(key)+len(val) > MaxBytes/64), ErrNotCounter.
hashKey uses hash/maphash with a random per-process seed — shard placement is stable within a process but not reproducible across restarts.
Eviction is CLOCK per shard: expired entries first, then live entries whose reference mark (set by a Get hit or a rewrite) is clear; marked entries get the mark cleared and are skipped.
key_characteristics: Sharded (64 shards, padded to cache lines) for concurrent R/W
Bounded: each shard holds MaxEntries/64 entries and MaxBytes/64 bytes; a full cache evicts, never fails
Monotonic-clock expiry; an expired entry is absent for every method before any sweep
No goroutine or timer while empty or when no entry expires

critical_rules: NEVER hold onto context after request completes
NEVER mutate context after guard stage
NEVER access raw websocket.Conn in handlers (use Publisher)
NEVER retain pooled objects beyond request lifetime
Code after next() runs before the next layer, not after the handler: post-handler work belongs in an interceptor's Pipe operators
Configuration only in AppOptions (checked at New); BindGlobal* only before Create
Providers are fields, never handler parameters

Pages are RENDER_ / SUBMIT_ routes: the route picks the template (<path>.html or <path>/index.html), the only or last result is the data; there is no owlkei.Page or owlkei.View. Template functions are fixed (nonce, asset, dict, pageAssets): no user FuncMap

Errors: a matched page route from its first guard on answers HTML (<code>.html, then <N>xx.html, then built-in), an API / SERVE / asset / public file route JSON; before any guard (middlewares, 404, 405, 410) HTML only when Accept contains text/html. A cause's text and a 500's own message never reach the client
common_mistakes: Type mismatch between provider and handler parameter
Calling next() multiple times in middleware
Slow clients causing message drops in WebSocket
Unexported fields in a pipe (form DTO): Create() panics `dependency injection: can't set value to unexported ...` like any injected struct
JavaScript comments in an inline <script> of a template: html/template strips them; use {{/* */}}
